preconditions.description: The size of the grid n must be between 1 and 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) == n for line in grid)
preconditions.description: Each line in the grid must have exactly n characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'SG.' for line in grid for c in line)
preconditions.description: Each character in the grid must be either 'S', 'G', or '.'.

postconditions.description: The output must be one of the strings 'UNIQUE', 'NONE', or 'MULTIPLE'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'UNIQUE' and len(output_grid) == n and all(len(line) == n for line in output_grid)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'UNIQUE', the additional lines must form a valid n x n grid.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'UNIQUE' and all(c in 'SG' for line in output_grid for c in line)
postconditions.description: If the output is 'UNIQUE', all characters in the output grid must be either 'S' or 'G'.
